import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Fix out-of-range body mass (e.g., value entered in milligrams or typo)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island')['penguin_id'].count()
    return {island: int(count) for island, count in counts.items()}
